# Module 16 — multithreading

Allowed: modules 1–15, plus `Thread`, `Runnable`, `sleep`, `join`, `synchronized`, `volatile`, `wait`, and `notify`.

Do not suggest or require: `ExecutorService`, locks from `java.util.concurrent`, concurrent collections, file I/O, or web APIs.

Review only the basic threading the task asks for.
